title: Resolve real supplier and affiliation identity through explicit global keys
reason: User vendors carry LEI or registration authority+number; scholarly affiliations carry ROR. Proposed LEI→accounting parents/exceptions/jurisdiction and ROR→GeoNames feature/country→economic context support group-concentration and affiliation-coverage questions. Visuals: relationship network with role/period badges and map. Actual ROR sample exposes GeoNames ID,an observed public bridge. No accepted synthetic-demo organisation match; all six demo roles are only schema analogies. Needs real keyed user fixture,authority namespace checks,exact relationship schema/periods and code-list rights. ROR organisations need not be legal entities.
practical_value: Proposed connected bundle; identity, temporal, legal and match-rate review required. Not selected or implemented.
showcase_value: Named visualisations support the questions; practical joinability dominates.
